summary: Add a new separate Python FastAPI image-to-3D reconstruction service under the existing repository with provider-neutral execution modes and Render-friendly defaults.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: Existing Java backend and React frontend are present; user requested adding a new service without modifying current Java behavior.

questions.question: Which programming language for Reconstruction API?
questions.rationale: User explicitly approved creating a new separate Python service.

questions.question: Which backend framework for Reconstruction API?

options.label: FastAPI
options.description: ASGI framework with OpenAPI and async support

questions.rationale: User requirement explicitly asks for a new FastAPI service.

questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Reconstruction API.
questions.recommendedChoice: POST /v1/reconstructions (multipart images, optional antique_id), GET /v1/reconstructions/{job_id}, GET /health, GET /v1/capabilities, provider-neutral engine modes (local/external-worker/disabled), image validation, six-view input, durable local job metadata and artifact directories, CORS and configuration, tests and Render deployment notes.
questions.answer: POST /v1/reconstructions (multipart images, optional antique_id), GET /v1/reconstructions/{job_id}, GET /health, GET /v1/capabilities, provider-neutral engine modes (local/external-worker/disabled), image validation, six-view input, job status/progress/error/model_url contract, durable local job metadata and artifact directories, CORS and configuration, Dockerfile/requirements/tests/README/Render notes.
questions.rationale: Directly inferred from the approved user requirements.

questions.question: Which data stores does your app need?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The app does not persist data or use storage, queues, or caches

questions.rationale: The service receives and persists image/media artifacts and reconstruction outputs, so object storage is required by default guidance.

questions.question: Does this app need user login?

options.label: Yes
